detail.title: Wireless dual Collar Microphone
detail.overview: Discover the Wireless dual Collar Microphone by Bestor, engineered for high performance, durability, and seamless connectivity.
features: Perfect for two-person podcasting and interviews.
Captures sound from all directions clearly.
Automatic pairing with low latency connection.
Up to 10 hours of continuous recording time.
Reliable wireless range up to 20 meters.
Works with iOS, Android, and OTG supported devices.
